prompt: Predict the major mononitration product of m-bromotoluene.

acceptable.label: 5-nitro isomer (ortho to methyl, meta to Br)

traps.note: Both methyl (o/p) and Br (o/p, weakly deactivating) reinforce ortho/para to methyl, not this position.

explanation: Methyl is a stronger activator/director than Br. Both are o/p directors, so their preferences reinforce and the position para to the stronger activator (methyl) is preferred.
